title: MCP Fuzzer: Automated Boundary and Schema Stress-Tester for MCP Servers

title: claude-tool-guard: Real-time secret and PII redactor for tool-using Claude agents
one_liner: A zero-dependency Python wrapper for the Anthropic SDK that intercepts tool call inputs and outputs to block credential leaks and PII before execution.

title: claude-trace-diff - CLI tool call regression tester for Anthropic agents
one_liner: A CLI tool that captures Anthropic SDK tool execution sequences and flags argument drifts, missing tool calls, and hallucinations across prompt iterations.

title: Claude Callgraph – Visualize Claude tool-use traces
one_liner: A CLI that turns Claude agent tool-call logs into instant Mermaid diagrams for rapid debugging and insight

title: agent-diff-audit: AI PR Churn and Bloat Evaluator
one_liner: A CLI and GitHub Action that evaluates AI agent git diffs for code churn, redundant refactoring, and token efficiency before merging.

title: canary-harness - Fault Injection Harness for Claude Tool Agents
one_liner: A testing framework that injects synthetic fault scenarios into Anthropic tool calls to evaluate agent error recovery.

title: Claude OpenAPI Diff – AI-powered API change detector
one_liner: A CLI that compares two OpenAPI specs and uses Claude to flag breaking changes with severity scores for developers and product teams.

title: Claude PR Fact‑Checker – Instant LLM Truth‑Gate for Pull Requests
one_liner: A Python/GitHub‑Action tool that uses Claude to verify factual claims in PR titles, descriptions and diffs, failing the CI check on likely false statements.

title: Claude ClipCut – Prompted video clipping CLI
